artifacts.content:
# Candidate 7 Isolation-Test Correction Verification

## Authentication

All ten declared context files matched their required raw SHA-256 digests and byte counts before inspection. They were rehashed after command execution and remained byte-identical. Candidate 7's receipt and raw logs therefore remain immutable failed evidence.

## Failure Correspondence

The authenticated Candidate 7 receipt records a failed canonical `npm.cmd run verify` invocation with exact source and post-command digests preserved, clean disposable Git state, clean live repository state, and successful cleanup. Its stdout records 405 tests, 404 passes, and one failure: `host TypeScript entrypoint supply is singular, plain, absolute, and external`. The failure is `ENOENT` from `lstat` of candidate-local `node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc`, reached through `resolveHostTypeScriptEntrypoint` when the unit test supplied an empty synthetic environment. This exactly matches the frozen diagnosis and retirement record. Candidate 7 was not rerun.

## Corrected Paths

`scripts/run-v12-release-gate.mjs` now permits the internal resolver seam to receive `defaultEntrypoint`, while retaining `DEFAULT_HOST_TYPESCRIPT_ENTRYPOINT` as the default when the third argument is omitted. The production `commandEnvironment` call still invokes `resolveHostTypeScriptEntrypoint(environment, gitContext.worktree)` with two arguments, removes every case-insensitive supply key, and writes one normalized `SWECIRCUIT_TYPESCRIPT_ENTRYPOINT` value.

Both explicit environment supply and injected default follow the same checks: non-empty string, absolute path, `lstat` rejection of symbolic links, plain regular-file enforcement, canonical `realpath`, and rejection when the canonical path is not outside the candidate materialization.

`test/v12-release-gate.test.mjs` creates a temporary external plain file and passes it as the resolver's test default. It proves successful canonical external resolution and rejects relative, symbolic, and candidate-contained injected defaults. The same test also retains explicit-supply coverage for duplicate case-insensitive keys, empty values, relative paths, missing paths, directories, symbolic links, and candidate-contained files.

## Focused Commands

`node --test --test-name-pattern="host TypeScript entrypoint supply" test\v12-release-gate.test.mjs` exited 0 with 1 test passed, 0 failed, in 103.4889 ms overall.

`npm.cmd exec -- biome check scripts/run-v12-release-gate.mjs test/v12-release-gate.test.mjs` exited 0, checked both files, and applied no fixes. It reported 14 informational `useTemplate` suggestions unrelated to the correction.

## Result

The exact Candidate 7 defect is causally closed without changing production host-supply behavior, weakening containment, expanding authority, mutating evidence, or creating candidate-local dependencies. This focused PASS is not release approval.

risks: This focused verification does not replace the integration owner's complete suite, successor one-shot canonical gate, or three-reviewer R2 release decision.
